name: kling-ai
description: Generate and edit images, create videos from text and reference media, and check your Kling AI credits and generation progress.

interface.longDescription: Create images and videos with Kling AI (可灵AI). Kling Image 4.0 supports text-to-image, reference-image editing, and connected image series, with native resolution up to 8K. Create product photos, posters, portraits, social media content, and videos with one or more shots. Kling 4.0 supports text-to-video, image-to-video with first, last, and intermediate keyframes, and Omni-Ref with images, videos, audio, and reusable subjects (Elements). It produces 3–30 second videos at 720p. Eligible accounts can request 1080p or 4K with optional HDR when supported by the connected model. Kling 4.0 Flash is optimized for speed and produces 3–20 second videos at 720p from text, a single first-frame image, or Omni-Ref with images, videos, and Elements. Both Omni-Ref models support smart shot splitting and a choice between synchronized sound generation and source-video sound retention. Use models with motion control to transfer a saved motion or a reference video to a subject image. Upload reference images, videos, and audio, manage Elements, browse the motion library, check your credit balance, and track generation progress. A connected Kling AI account is required. Generation uses Kling AI credits. Model availability and supported settings vary by account.
defaultPrompt: 使用可灵图片 4.0 一次生成 3 张 8K 连续组图：同一只身穿复古宇航服的小熊猫依次从空间站出舱、掠过舷窗、转身望向蓝色地球。
使用可灵 4.0 生成一段 20 秒电影感视频：机甲战士从高空重砸地面，冲击波瞬间震开碎石与尘雾，镜头快速推近，充满力量感。
使用可灵 4.0 Flash，把我提供的运动鞋商品图作为首帧，生成一段 20 秒、720p 的视频。镜头缓慢绕过鞋身，最后停在鞋面细节上。
